name: Yandere is for lovers
source:
Help our heroine in 2007 navagate community college, friendship, and Aidy while the grim realities of the town start to encircle her.  Work hard to figure out whats happening to those around her without endangering her or anyone else for that matter.

[From [url=https://charpal.itch.io/yandere-is-for-lovers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
回到2007年，帮助我们的女主角在社区大学生活、友情以及与艾迪的关系之间周旋，同时应对小镇逐渐向她逼近的残酷现实。努力查明身边众人遭遇的真相，同时切莫让她自己或是其他任何人陷入险境。

[摘自[url=https://charpal.itch.io/yandere-is-for-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
